name: binding
wording: how a composed agent meets one harness: its model and effort through a model role named for it, its reach as that harness's tool and dispatch permissions, its method as skills; the agent is the same on every harness, and only its binding differs.
reason: Discovery 2026-10-10: the canon's model was a bare token and its reach was not projected as permissions; a definition must be portable while its enforcement is native.
